title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E13 — The Moblins Are Revolting
Ganon demonstrates a new wand that makes a bubble around its victim that can only be popped by the Triforce of Power; fed up with Ganon's orders, a Moblin uses the wand to trap Ganon in a bubble and throws him down a bottomless pit.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E1 — The Ringer
Link's only consolation for the boring duty of guarding the Triforce of Wisdom is keeping company with Princess Zelda, who does not feel the same way.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E2 — Cold Spells
The first days of spring mark spring-cleaning at Hyrule Castle; Link fakes a cold to avoid chores; Ganon infiltrates the castle and, to create a distraction, covertly augments Sprite's magical powers as she too performs cleaning chores.

title: Casper the Friendly Ghost

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S2 E21 — Indiana Pac and the Dentures of Doom
The diabolical dentures of an evil Mummy wizard could cause the destruction of PacWorld.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S2 E22 — Honey, I Digitized the Pac-Man
When Dr. Buttocks infects Pac-World's computers with his virus ghosts, a digitized Pac must travel through cyberspace and stop the invasion before the evil scientist can download the location of the Repository and the Tree of Life.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S2 E25 — Santa Pac
Betrayus plans to put an end to PacWorld's most festive holiday by getting rid of the holiday's icon, Santa Pac.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:

He-Man and Battle Cat are overpowered by Skeletor's newly formed Council of Evil, but manage to escape capture by transforming back into their other selves.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:

Zodak comes to the rescue of the Sorceress and builds a force field around Castle Grayskull; Orko hands Prince Adam his Power Sword to keep Skeletor at bay.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:
S2 E2 — To Walk With Dragons
Skeletor uses Beast Man's flying serpents to attack King Randor's council meeting.

description:
S1 E31 — Lost Friend Will Zee
Talking Tom's long-lost childhood pal Will Zee comes crashing in for a visit; but Tom is thrown for a loop when Will turns out to be way cooler than the bed-wetter he remembers from summer camp.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E32 — Angela's Secret
Talking Tom knows that Talking Angela is a health nut, but that doesn't explain the amount of fruit in her house; convinced she's gone bananas, he eats.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E33 — Jetpack Ninja
Talking Hank gives Talking Ginger a lesson in the ways of a ninja warrior; but the young grasshopper doesn't always have the patience for learning ninja skills; when a jetpack gets involved, it becomes an uphill battle to fight for good, not evil.

The Rabbids are shut inside a supermarket after closing hours; the janitor has a radio, around which the Rabbids gather to dance, but they cause all sorts of interference when they get too close to the radio.

A damsel in distress from a dragon refuses help from Princess Zelda, but after being saved by Link, the lady rewards her hero with a kiss that turns him into a frog.

Link plans an attempt at romancing Zelda by swinging into her window from above by a rope; the attempt is interrupted as Ganon rides a flying unicorn over the castle and kidnaps the king for ransom.
